svg.text: One consistent OS identity. Six different atmospheres.
Original vector assets · true 16 / 24 / 32 px samples · existing emblem retained
Semantic shapes stay familiar: folder, terminal prompt, envelope, globe, settings cog.
Neutral ink, 24px construction grid, 1.75px rounded strokes, restrained shared geometry.
Third-party application brands remain upstream through inherited icon themes.
ASSET PROOF / panel arrangement above is a static study, not a running desktop capture.
